# Allied AI War Fix

**Version 1.0** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3820079745) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=allied-ai-war-fix&expanded=true)

Stop the AI from starting wars it expects *you* to fight.

## The problem

Before the AI declares an offensive war, it adds up the strength of its side. That total counts every ally, players included. So an AI ruler allied to you happily attacks someone far stronger, counting your armies as its own, and you get called into a war you never wanted (or watch your ally get crushed when you decline).

## The fix

When the AI weighs an offensive war, only its **AI** allies count towards its strength. Players are never assumed to join. Everything else about how the AI judges a war is exactly the base game's.

That is the whole change: two conditions in the value the AI uses for its own side's strength.

## Built on the game's own file

The value lives in a file the game also uses for many other war calculations, and a mod can only change it by replacing the whole file. This mod's file is **generated from CK3 1.20's own**, with only those two conditions added. Nothing the base game added is lost: Frankokratia, house relations, Peace of God, zealous wars on a head of faith, the shorter truce between nomads and the rest all work as Paradox intended.

## Credit

The idea comes from [Allied AI Offensive War Fix](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3260179649), made for CK3 1.12. Its copy of the file predates 1.20, so it removes values the current game relies on. This is a fresh build of the same fix for the current game; none of the original's files are used.

## Compatibility

- Built for **CK3 1.20 "Crozier"** (By God Alone).
- **Replaces Allied AI Offensive War Fix.** Do not run both.
- Conflicts with any other mod that replaces *common/script_values/00_war_values.txt*. Whichever loads last wins.
- Safe to add or remove mid-game.
- Changes no achievement-relevant rules, but, as with any mod, check the launcher for achievement compatibility.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `allied-ai-war-fix-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=allied-ai-war-fix&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
